product.title: Pearl Harbor: USS Arizona Memorial and Battleship Missouri Tour

description.text: Pickup at a Waikiki hotel goes to Pearl Harbor for the USS Arizona Memorial and the Battleship Missouri. The ride goes to the Pearl Harbor National Museum, and included tickets cover the Pearl Harbor National Memorial and the Battleship Missouri Memorial, including time aboard the battleship. Drop-off returns to Waikiki hotels. This Honolulu visit covers the attack on Pearl Harbor and World War II, with those tickets included. Boarding the battleship is included with the Missouri ticket on this Honolulu booking.
